headline: Dua Associates advises Piramal Finance on sanctioning ₹250 crore for Nimbus - The Palm Village
sum: Piramal Finance Limited has extended financing aggregating ₹250 crore, including ₹200 crore extended to Nimbus Projects Limited and ₹50 crore to IITL-NIMBUS THE PALM VILLAGE. Dua Associates advised Piramal Finance on this financing deal.
detail: Piramal Finance Limited has extended financing aggregating ₹250 crore, including ₹200 crore extended to Nimbus Projects Limited and ₹50 crore to IITL-NIMBUS THE PALM VILLAGE. Dua Associates advised Piramal Finance on this financing deal. The transaction team consisted of Prateek Bedi (Partner), Angad Varma (Partner), Nityashjit Kaur (Partner), Bhaskar Mishra (Partner), Toyesh Tiwari (Partner), Rishabh Halwai (Principal Associate) and Anukriti Prakash (Senior Associate). Prateek Bedi, Angad Varma, Nityashjit Kaur, Bhaskar Mishra, Toyesh Tiwari The funding will support the development of the residential group housing project, Nimbus-The Palm Village, located in the Yamuna Expressway…
